title: Clothes dryers.
officialText:
Where three or fewer clothes dryers are provided, at least one shall comply with ICC A117.1, including
Section 611 (Washing Machines and Clothes Dryers), and shall be front loading. Where more than three clothes dryers are provided, at least two shall comply with ICC A117.1, including Section 611, and shall be front loading.
